These are invented, offline fixtures, with no real employer or posting. greenhouse.json uses the Greenhouse listing field shape; registry.json is project-owned synthetic review configuration and does not assert real retrieval/publication permission. No live requests are authorized or required. Provider positive integer IDs are required for V0; missing IDs quarantine/reject rather than URL-derived fallback. Stable identity hashes ATS + hosting region + board + provider ID, independent of title, pay and project source aliases. Source-ID migration requires operator review. URL fallback is deferred.
